notes.title: Updated
notes.content:
Updated the content of the second half of chapter 2 of the judges' line. The Ming Empire is about to split, and civil war is on the verge. And you are in a terrible situation, losing the East City, and now you are just a nobody. In order to save your own life in this situation, you must think of some other ways. ....

[*] Updated the follow-up content of Chapter 2 of Judge Line. According to the selection, there will be two plot lines in the follow-up.
